source_metadata.title: The Effectiveness of Nirsevimab on Antibiotic Use in Children Using Target Trial Emulation
source_metadata.study_design: Retrospective observational cohort using sequential target trial emulation

extraction_limitations: The uploaded PDF contains the 8-page main article; supplementary tables referenced by the article were not included in the supplied file.
Exact ICD-10 code lists and antibiotic lists used to operationalize outcomes were reported as being in Supplementary Tables 1-4 and therefore could not be atomized from the supplied main-text PDF.
No study-level appraisal was converted into reported data; limitation atoms are limited to limitations stated by the authors.
Risk ratios were not back-calculated from nirsevimab effectiveness because the source directly reports effectiveness and the workflow does not require derived estimates.
All language-model extracted atoms are marked needs_review rather than verified.
output_contract_note: ciag406_atoms.json is a JSON array; every array element individually validates as a LiteratureAtom against the governing Pydantic model/schema.
